PAGE.TITLE: Codex CLI
PAGE.CONTENT:
Command line (dochttps://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/cli/reference
enHTML)
codex resume Continue a previous interactive session by ID.
codex update Check for and apply a Codex CLI update when the installed release supports self-update.
codex app-server daemon update Update the background local server.
Slash commands (dochttps://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/cli/slash-commands
enHTML)
/exit
/quit Exit the CLI.
/new Start a new chat inside the same CLI session.
/resume Resume a saved chat.
/cd Change the session’s working directory.
/pwd
/cwd Show the working directory.
/compact Compact the chat.
/recap Generate a summary of the current conversation.
/export Export the conversation as Markdown.
/compact Compact the chat.
/rename Rename the current chat.
/archive Archive the current session.
Remove the current session from active session lists without deleting its transcript.
/delete Permanently delete the current session.
Remove the transcript and descendant sessions when archiving isn’t enough.
/init Create an AGENTS.md file with instructions for Codex.
/clear Clear the terminal and start a new chat.
/status Show current session configuration.
/permissions Choose what Codex is allowed to do.
/model Choose what model and reasoning effort to use.
/fast Toggle a Fast service tier when the model catalogue exposes one.
/daemon Manage the local background server.
/plugins Browse installed and discoverable plugins.
/mcp List configured Model Context Protocol (MCP) tools.
/hooks Review and manage lifecycle hooks.
/plan Switch to plan mode and optionally send a prompt.
/review Review any changes and find issues.
/usage View account token usage or use a rate-limit reset.
/side
/btw Start an ephemeral side chat.
/daybreak Enable/disable daybreak.
/feedback Send feedback or save a diagnostic ZIP.
/statusline Configure TUI status-line fields interactively.
/title Configure terminal window or tab title fields interactively.
/theme Choose a syntax-highlighting theme.
To declare a global MCP server codex mcp add \ gitlab \ --env GITLAB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN="$GITLAB_TOKEN" \ --env GITLAB_API_URL="https://gitlab.com" \ --env GITLAB_PERMISSION_MODE=readonly \ --env GITLAB_TOOLSETS=projects,merge_requests,issues \ -- npx -y @zereight/mcp-gitlab@2.1.65 (Declaring a local server needs to modify .codex/config.toml.)
